verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a media relay and protocol stack, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. An llms.txt file and the libraries, CLI and OBS plugin are adjacent features, not an MCP server agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
